# Ordinary coupled-policy Ultra fixture

`cases.bin` preserves 44 independently audited pinned zstd v1.5.7 fresh-parser
cases under whole-bit Optimal and fractional Ultra policies. All twenty original
Optimal source requests remain unchanged under both policies, plus two frozen
alternative-branch sources under each policy. The 25429567-byte little-endian
`ZUFFX01` pack contains 198476 complete logical events and 201 signed alternatives.
Persistent sparse path/frequency/search deltas reconstruct every owner state;
frames and allocation ledgers are retained native observations.

`provenance.json` binds packets, native transcripts, frames and original evidence.
The original capture evidence records an auditor bound error on the deliberate
oversize negative; a separately hashed successor audit qualifies all observations.
See `docs/reference-ultra-validation.md` and its archived capture/sidecar reports.

The projection and independent source-driven reconstruction agree byte for byte
in normal and optimized Python; each reconstruction rejects 28 forgeries. Opaque
native frames and allocation ledgers retain exact audited identities rather than
being represented as model predictions. This fixture does not enable public Ultra.

Reference: facebook/zstd v1.5.7, commit
`f8745da6ff1ad1e7bab384bd1f9d742439278e99`. Upstream is BSD-3-Clause or GPL-2.0;
see the repository attribution records. Reference source stays outside this repo.
